changes.description: Added explicit output path requirement: final video must be saved to /workspace/output/final.mp4
Added format requirement: MP4 with H.264 video codec, minimum resolution 1280x720
Extended single-prompt into a long-form multi-shot video task: 15-30 seconds depicting sunset progression over time
Added requirement for multiple shots showing the sky at different stages of the sunset

note: The original VBench prompt describes content only. The instruction adds output format/path and long-form video requirements without specifying any tool call sequence, planning steps, or skill invocation order. The agent decides how to accomplish the task.
